crowdsourcing is a form of disaster convergence, the CSCW concept of articulation work is useful for extracting the key dimensions of crowdsourcing, and the Crisis Crowdsourcing framework provides a systematic way to design and manage crowdsourcing systems.

crisis crowdsourcing is a new form of articulation work that is being formalized through the design of new technologies and organizational structures to support the articulating work of crisis volunteers.
crisis crowdsourcing has evolved from spontaneous volunteer efforts to formalized efforts that are integrated into official products, services and policies.

the design of crisis crowdsourcing systems that leverage the power of the crowd to improve the effectiveness of the response to disasters.
how to better design and manage crowdsourcing efforts to improve disaster resilience and recovery.
the design of strategic configurations of crowdsourcing for the emergency management domain.

crowdsourcing is an innovative approach to crisis informatics that can be used as an alternative to the traditional command and control model.
crowdsourcing is a new paradigm of disaster management that is being integrated into the official disaster response system.
the crisis crowdsourcing framework provides a way to design strategic configurations of crowdsourcing to support disaster response and recovery efforts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
crisis crowdsourcing is a complex and dynamic process that requires the design of a crisis crowdsourcing framework to manage the complexity of coordinating these key dimensions.

crisis crowdsourcing is not just about the technology or the crowd, it is about the articulation work that is required to coordinate the social, technological and policy interfaces that support the crowd to contribute to the crisis management process.
crowdsourcing is an emergent phenomenon that is evolving from a social phenomenon to a technological phenomenon.
The main takeaway from our work is that
crisis crowdsourcing is an emergent phenomenon that can be leveraged to enhance disaster preparedness and response.
crowdsourcing is a form of articulation work that is being formalized and integrated into the official products and services of emergency management.
crisis crowdsourcing systems are not just about the technology, but about the articulation work that needs to occur across all of the interfaces.
